title: Forward Converter (Single-Switch)
description: Single-switch forward converter with a third reset winding, coupled-inductor transformer (K1), and LC output filter. Steps 48 V down to roughly 9.2 V (n=0.5, n31=1, D=0.4, fsw=100 kHz). Authored clean-room with qspice-mcp tools and validated end-to-end.
